results.title: 1,000,000,000 - Wikipedia
results.description:
# 1,000,000,000
**1,000,000,000** ("one [billion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billion)" on the [short scale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_and_short_scales); "one milliard" on the [long scale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_and_short_scales); one thousand million) is the [natural number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_number) following [999,999,999](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/100,000,000#900,000,000_to_999,999,999) and preceding 1,000,000,001.

In standard form, it is written as **1 × 109**.

However, this is not common anymore, and the word has been used to mean one thousand million (1,000,000,000) for several decades.

In the [Indian numbering system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_numbering_system), it is known as 100 [crore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crore) or 1 [arab](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_numbering_system).

1,000,000,000 is also the [cube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cube_(algebra)) of [1000](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1000_(number)).

It is a common metric used in [macroeconomics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macroeconomics) when describing national economies.
